mcqs.q: If one EM wave has a higher frequency than another, what is true about its wavelength?
options: It is also longer, because both increase together.
It is shorter — wavelength and frequency are inversely related (c = f x lambda).
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.
It is unchanged — only the speed differs.

mcqs.q: When energy is 'lost' as heat due to friction, what has really happened?
options: It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
Energy has been transferred to the thermal store of the surroundings — it's not destroyed, just dissipated.
Energy has been used up and no longer exists.
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.

mcqs.q: What happens to the current as it goes around a series circuit?
options: Current splits in half at the battery so each direction gets some.
It stays the same at every point — current is conserved.
Current gets used up by each component as it flows around the circuit.
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.
